name: sudoku-solver-shell-tests
description: The installable shell, as opposed to the page inside it: sw.js run outside a browser in a vm sandbox, and the host configuration that serves the worker and the manifest from the root. Kept apart from tests/ui because neither of these boots a page — they need no jsdom and no dependencies at all — and because a failing service worker and a page that discards what the engine said are different failures that should read differently in CI.
